title: Authoritative Accepted Full-Interval Mass Accounting

storage_accounting.ownership: transaction_model_t%storage reports persistent physical water storage only; model-specific adapters own active-store composition
storage_accounting.optional_inactive: no contribution and no persistent accounting payload required

external_flux_accounting.sign_policy: physics sign conventions are unchanged; model/adapter supplies aggregate mass_in and mass_out to canonical accounting

internal_transfer_handling.focused_test: transfer between two persistent stores changes neither total storage balance nor external inflow/outflow accounting

completeness_semantics.complete_true: all storage and external flux contributions required by the active physical configuration are present exactly once, all terms are finite, at least one accepted transaction exists, and the full requested interval completed
completeness_semantics.complete_false: one or more required active contributions are missing, storage accounting is incomplete, an accepted trial reports incomplete accounting, a term is nonfinite, provenance is incomplete, or the requested interval did not complete

transaction_semantics.authoritative_route: only the ultimately accepted TX_ROUTE_TWO_HALF branch contributes accepted mass terms
